models.name: htdemucs
models.license_note: Demucs weights licensing is genuinely unresolved (RISK-1). The code is MIT, but the author stated in repository issues (#267, #327, #508) that the weights are not covered by MIT and are provided for research purposes, citing MUSDB dataset terms -- while a later Hugging Face model card carries an 'mit' license tag. The contradiction is unresolved. This model is not presented as unambiguously safe; review the source discussion yourself before accepting.
